book.name: GALATIYA
book.title: Galatiya wali Leta Pol wana Leleli

content: Avalau Ta Label ali Pulowan Ta Wali

Taliwau ge nuwau, ebo wami boda ana gamagal etega gegi etega ni ginol, komiu bolo Yayaluwa Bwabwalena i logugui-agimiu, alomiu wami hanalau ge wami pagan meimeina gamagal o nuku labe ge wana pagan nuku pasapu. Yaa nuku matahikagimiu bahi komiu lawakik nuku pwapwawa ge nuku sosogu.
Alomiyau nuku label ali pulowan nuku kaval wali. Nuku ginol ola, inoke eliyana Keliso wana logugui nuku paolaolaek.
Ebo gamagal etega totona i ba heyan tage alana i bwata, yaa age nige alana i bwabwata, he totona i kakawe.
Komiu maisena ge maisena totona wana pagan ni kite hilihili-an ga. Ebo wana ginol ni waisi, he ni yaliyaya. Yaa bahi iya wana ginol ana waisi ni luviluviek alona wana ginol elana,
kaiwena gamagal maisena ge maisena iya ana usan ni loke ge pulowanina ni kalivai.
Ebo wam topankite Yehoba wana baaba i panpankiti-an eliyam, inoke wam bugul waiwaisal enuna nu guyauan wam topankite elana.
Nuku nuwatu bubun ge nuwamiu ni sapu te nige bosowaina etega Yehoba ni kakawe. Hauna toto ta luwan, he enona ta ken ni ola to.
Ebo tuwala yawalina elana ta luwaluwana, enona ta ken yaomal. Yaa ebo Yayaluwa Bwabwalena elana ta luwaluwana, enona ta ken yawal mihomihotina.
Bahi pagan waiwaisana ana awaawaginol ta eesaian, kaiwena ebo nige ta pwepweyata-an, ana sauga hot elana enona waiwaisana ta pwawa.
Inoke hauna sauga ge i bosowaila pagan waiwaisana ta ginol avalau gegewel elal, inoke ta ginol. He pagan waiwaisana ta gagasisi-an wala pan toabulilek elal Keliso ana un elana.
Liwan ana Kaukaus
Sauga ya totou nimwau elana na leleli.
He nuku kite nimwau mulina ya leli pwabwata.

Gamagalau bolo hi ba palawakikimiu tage gotomwa yoho paganina nuku ahe, he hi ginol ola kaiwena nuwaliya avaliyau nihi yaliyaya-agil. Heliya hi lololovakun ge hi nuwatu hi ola, “Bahi palopalomwan ta pwapwawa kaiwena ta abulilek Keliso wana yaomal elana.”
Bwagana bolo gotomwa yoho paganina hi ahe, heliya nige logugui hi totoulil. Yaa nuwaliya tuwamiu buhuna kunisina nihi gotomwa yoho, inoke nihi pahanaha-agil kaiwena bugul ya hi ginol tuwamiu elana.

Yaa nau elau, nige bugul etega kaiwena ge na hanaha, yaa wala Babala Yeisu Keliso te na tobalan. Wana yaomal kolos elana heiya te ya yaliyaya-an. Yeisu wana yaomal eliyana i ola te panayawi paganina iyaka i yaomal eliyau ge ya towani. Ge i ola te nau iyaka ya yaomal kolos elana, inoke nige bosowaina panayawi paganina na toulil.
Bwagana ebo gotomwa yoho paganina ta ahe o ebo nige ta aahe, nige bugul i oola. He toto ana nuwatu i bwata heiya te kila ta tabwa ginol vavaluna.
Komiu bolo nuwatu ya ku awa wawaisi-an, komiu boda Isileli hot Yehoba wana gamagalau. Inoke ya awanun Yehoba atemiu ni palaumwal ge ni atilomwan-agimiu.
Sauga matalaa bahi komiu etegana ni sisinali-agau o ebo o pulowan ni teteli, kaiwena potpot bolo hi minaa tuwawa, o etotohi to, hi pamasal nau Yeisu wana totuwalali loloyowanina.
Taliwau ge nuwau, wala Babala Yeisu Keliso wana mulolu ni minaa yayaluwamiu elana. Ibwe. I ola.

footnotes.text: Buki ya awalehina gegewena ana baaba Pol i baunan, yaa gamagal getoga te i leli lowan ana siga 6:10 elana.
